card.name: Inside long drug names
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of long, rare drug names such as Dox-erc-alciferol and fil-gr-astim. Also seen in a few odd names or old-style words split into pieces.

modes.label: Drug name middle
modes.description: A middle piece of a long generic drug name, usually before the ending is spelled out.

modes.example: under the code name PARL<<OR>> MAID.

card.writes: It promotes odd word-piece endings, so it seems to help finish a long rare name rather than add a meaning.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long, uncommon drug names, like doxercalciferol or filgrastim, while the name is still being spelled out.
